what: 2 m air temperature, the 1951–1980 average of each 2° cell, for each calendar month and the year; the app adds GISS’s anomaly to it for its Absolute mode

method.source: ERA5 1990–2019, WeatherBench 2’s 6-hourly day-of-year climatology at 1.5°, mean of its four hours, calendar months (29 February weighted 1/4)
method.unsmoothed: its 61-day window undone for harmonics 1–3 of each cell’s 12 months (gains [0.9549, 0.827, 0.6367])
method.regrid: first-order conservative, exact overlap in longitude × sin(latitude)
method.shift: minus GISS’s mean anomaly for the cell and calendar month over 1990–2019 (at least 20 of 30 years; 1765 cell-months took their row’s mean), GISTEMP grid created 2026-08-10 06:37:42 (history attribute); 1,759 months, 1880-01 .. 2026-07, sha256 93f73f648a5e43b2870880865406ae98d35b03146612717e538d48a3bec02425
method.year: the plain mean of the 12 months
